user.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer
user.description: Adds a read-only map of your Zigbee network to the sidebar. Nothing needs to be configured.

init.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer Options
init.description: Changes take effect when you save; Home Assistant itself is not restarted.

data_description.sidebar: Off removes the panel from the sidebar and from the address /meshroute-topology.
data_description.radio_actions: Off hides the scan button and the attribute read in the panel. It is a switch of this panel, not a lock: ZHA's own pages still offer both.

history.name: Reception history
history.description: Records the reception values of the neighbour tables that ZHA and the Matter server already hold. It never starts a scan. ZHA reads its tables only every 4 hours by default.

data.confirm_short: Record more often than every {recommended} hours anyway

data_description.confirm_short: Only needed for an interval under {recommended} hours.
data_description.delete_history: Deletes all records when you save. Not kept as a setting.

error.hours_short: More often than every {recommended} hours: ZHA reads its tables only every 4 hours by default, so most records repeat the last values. A finer history needs a shorter scan period in ZHA, and every scan asks each router for its tables: more radio traffic in the whole network. Tick the box to record every {hours} hours anyway.
